apps.name: Base
apps.subtitle: Talk to your agents from iPhone and iPad.
apps.localizedDescription: Base is the native Riad client for following sessions, dictating prompts, and sending messages to your agents.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds a top-bar jump-to-latest control on macOS and iOS, replaces Stop while reading scrollback, and enables the iOS Send button immediately for prompt answers.

Restores the macOS copy-confirmation checkmark and shows complete normal transcript responses instead of ellipsis previews on macOS and iOS. Also hardens transactional macOS relaunches so staged updates reopen reliably without losing deferred windows.

Improved on-device dictation with a higher-accuracy iPhone default, deterministic decoding, final-word capture, environmental-noise cleanup, and safe lone-word suppression. Also includes hardened Markdown/LaTeX rendering, clearer status rails, per-window macOS compact sidebars, reliable window restoration, and remembered names for disconnected devices.

Super Dark appearance for macOS and iOS: true-black surfaces, white text, green selected rows, stronger separators, and a VS Code High Contrast-style accent. System appearance remains the default; the new mode is persisted from Settings.

Long-run resilience release: bounded daemon and transcript data, durable render-crash fallback, structural SwiftMath validation with the repaired parser pin, safe persisted-state recovery, corrected window/new-chat commands, and hardened macOS/iOS update paths.
Fix the SwiftMath table-script crash, make future math typesetter traps self-healing, and harden exact macOS window restoration across updates.
Launchable stable macOS updates, mathtools small-matrix rendering, and the public SideStore feed.
Signed automatic macOS updates and a public SideStore feed, backed by immutable release artifacts.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Base transcribes your voice on-device to message your agents.
